title: hosta japonica var. aurea

This plant is valued for its beautiful foliage, with golden yellow leaves that provide a striking contrast to its green counterparts. The Golden Hosta has been used in traditional medicine, where it is believed to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of the Golden Hosta include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its potential to calm the nervous system and reduce anxiety.
